title: How it works
subtitle: From multi-currency invoicing to local settlement – in just minutes

steps.title: Business creates a multi-currency invoice
steps.description: In your dashboard you enter the amount you want to receive – in VND, KRW, THB, AED or other currencies. The system instantly generates a dynamic payment link and QR code.

steps.title: Client pays in their local currency
steps.description: The client pays in their domestic currency using their local bank app, cards, QR codes, or bank transfers with zero friction.

steps.title: You receive settlement instantly
steps.description: Funds are credited to your account right after payment and settled into your preferred currency (VND, KRW, USDT, etc.) based on your treasury rules.

notice_desktop: The exchange rate is locked for 30 minutes: the client pays exactly the amount shown on screen with zero volatility risk
notice_mobile: The exchange rate is locked for 30 minutes. This protects your deals from sharp market fluctuations
